purpose: Document first-party local land-registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry-route review.
assessment: SagarGIS is described as a district-level planning/infrastructure GIS; the documented layers do not include parcel boundaries. The state land-record service is record lookup, not a verified public feature API.
registryAssessment: The district administration identifies a Land Record Office at Collectorate Sagar; this establishes local revenue/land-record activity, not anonymous parcel geometry at the WUP point.

officialPrimarySources.observation: District Sagar lists the Land Record Office at Collectorate Sagar and links the state land-record service.
Official district GIS description lists roads, water, sewer, land use, public assets, schools, hospitals and infrastructure; it does not identify cadastral parcels.
State Town and Country Planning page provides cadastral land-use planning maps; this is planning information, not a live cadastral parcel feature service.
